texts.FullStack_Developer_passionate_about_bui: Full-Stack Developer passionate about building beautiful, accessible, and high-performance web applications. Let's create something amazing together!

texts.From_curious_beginner_to_passionate: From curious beginner to passionate developer — every line of code has been a step forward.

milestones.title: The Spark
milestones.description: Wrote my first "Hello World" and got hooked, Was in grade 10 doing IT as a subject at highschool. What started as curiosity became a passion that would change everything.

milestones.title: Deep Dive
milestones.description: Finished matric, Started learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Built countless projects, broke things, fixed them, and learned the beauty of clean code.

milestones.title: Framework Era
milestones.description: Went into Varsity for my first year in Bsc Computer science and physics, Discovered React and fell in love with component-based architecture. Started building demo applications to learn more.

milestones.title: Full-Stack Journey
milestones.description: While traversing through university curricula, I Expanded into backend development with Node.js and databases. Understanding the full picture made me a better developer.

milestones.title: Continuous Growth
milestones.description: Now focused on performance, accessibility, and clean architecture. Every day is a new opportunity to learn and create.

texts.The_technologies_I_use_to: The technologies I use to bring ideas to life — from concept to deployment.

texts.heading: Featured
texts.description: A selection of projects that showcase my skills in building modern, user-focused applications.

projects.title: Champs Order Hub
projects.description: Online ordering for Champs Chicken, with pickup and delivery in Dikeni.
projects.longDescription: A digital ordering experience for Champs Chicken. Customers can browse the menu, order for pickup or delivery, and track their order.
projects.problem: Customers need a convenient way to explore the menu and order from their local restaurant.
projects.solution: A dedicated online hub brings menu browsing, ordering, and order tracking into one experience.

projects.title: UFH Opportunity Hub
projects.description: One hub for University of Fort Hare academic opportunities, from tutorships to bursaries and leadership roles.
projects.longDescription: UFH Opportunity Hub helps students discover and apply for academic opportunities with one profile, smart auto-fill, and a clear application journey.
projects.problem: Students need an easier way to discover and apply for opportunities across the university.
projects.solution: A central opportunity hub connects discovery, profiles, and applications in one place.

projects.title: MusicInsta
projects.description: A music community where artists and fans can discover, share, and connect.
projects.longDescription: MusicInsta brings music and community together, giving listeners a place to discover music and artists a space to connect with fans.
projects.problem: Artists and listeners need a shared space centered on music discovery and connection.
projects.solution: A dedicated social music platform with entry points for listeners and artists.

projects.title: TaskFlow Pro
projects.description: A modern task management app with real-time collaboration and smart productivity insights.
projects.longDescription: TaskFlow Pro is a comprehensive project management solution designed for remote teams. It features real-time updates, kanban boards, and AI-powered productivity analytics.
projects.problem: Remote teams struggle with task visibility and often lose track of project progress across time zones.
projects.solution: Built a real-time sync engine using WebSockets that keeps all team members updated instantly, with smart notifications that respect work hours.

projects.title: UFH Tutor Application & Management System
projects.description: Full-stack Tutor Application & Management System for the University of Fort Hare (UFH).
projects.longDescription: UFH Tutor Application & Management System streamlines the tutor application process for students and administrators at the University of Fort Hare. It offers a user-friendly interface for students to apply for tutoring positions and a robust admin panel for managing applications.
projects.problem: Administration of tutor applications at UFH was manual, time-consuming, and prone to errors.
projects.solution: Designed and developed a full-stack Tutor Application & Management System for the University of Fort Hare (UFH). The system allows students to register, apply for tutoring positions, upload supporting documents, save draft applications, and track application status. Administrators can securely review applications, manage statuses, and oversee user roles.

projects.title: WeatherWise
projects.description: Hyperlocal weather forecasting with beautiful visualizations and smart alerts.
projects.longDescription: WeatherWise provides accurate hyperlocal weather predictions using multiple data sources, presented through stunning animated visualizations.
projects.problem: Generic weather apps fail to capture microclimates and provide generic forecasts.
projects.solution: Integrated multiple weather APIs and used machine learning to improve accuracy for specific locations, presented through engaging SVG animations.

projects.title: DevNotes
projects.description: Markdown-powered note-taking designed specifically for developers.
projects.longDescription: DevNotes combines the simplicity of markdown with powerful developer features like code execution, git integration, and smart linking.
projects.problem: Existing note apps don't understand developer workflows and lack code-first features.
projects.solution: Built a custom markdown parser with code block execution, vim keybindings, and seamless git sync for version control.
